Periodically, the Shturman applies a shield of a specific element to themselves. There are 4 types of shields: @ffff3c00Piro@FF404040, @ff00fcffKrio@FF404040, @ff005affHydro@FF404040, @ff8a27ebElectro@FF404040. During this, you cannot damage the Sturman’s health directly, you must first destroy his shield.

To effectively break a Shturman’s shield, use elemental reactions. Sellect an elemental particle of the appropriate element and fire it at the shield. If the shield is not immune to that element, an elemental reaction will occur, dealing devastating damage to the shield.||Elemental reactions:||@ffff3c00Piro @FF404040+ @ff00fcffKrio @FF404040= @ff00fcffMelt|@ff00fcffKrio @FF404040+ @ffff3c00Piro @FF404040= @ff00fcffMelt||@ffff3c00Piro @FF404040+ @ff005affHydro @FF404040= @fffd7700Vaporize|@ff005affHydro @FF404040+ @ffff3c00Piro @FF404040= @fffd7700Vaporize||@ffff3c00Piro @FF404040+ @ff8a27ebElectro @FF404040= @ffc45145Overloaded|@ff8a27ebElectro @FF404040+ @ffff3c00Piro @FF404040= @ffc45145Overloaded||@ff00fcffKrio @FF404040+ @ff005affHydro @FF404040= @ffb5d7e6Frozen|@ff005affHydro @FF404040+ @ff00fcffKrio @FF404040= @ffb5d7e6Frozen||@ff00fcffKrio @FF404040+ @ff8a27ebElectro @FF404040= @ffd1d6fdSuperconduct|@ff8a27ebElectro @FF404040+ @ff00fcffKrio @FF404040= @ffd1d6fdSuperconduct||@ff005affHydro @FF404040+ @ff8a27ebElectro @FF404040= @ff8a27ebCharged|@ff8a27ebElectro @FF404040+ @ff005affHydro @FF404040= @ff8a27ebCharged

While operating the BRDM-2 during the battle against the Shturman, you can use the elemental cannon. Press the @FF1D1D1DHorn @FF404040key and select the element you wish the cannon to fire. There is no need to collect particles anymore—you decide which element to use.||@FF780a0aWarning:|@FF404040The damage-tracking system may not always function correctly; therefore, after the elemental cannon reloads, wait one second before firing. Additionally, it is recommended to refrain from firing other weapons while using the elemental cannon. You may resume full-scale fire only after the elemental projectile has reached the enemy and the hit has been registered.

By dealing a certain amount of damage to the Shturman, you can charge your own shield. While it may not be as sturdy, this shield is capable of protecting you against all types of reactions.||@FF780a0aWarning:|@FF404040Do not remove or install any gadgets on the cabin while the shield is active.
